headline: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Ads to Pakistan and 25 More Countries
summary: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT advertisements to Pakistan and 25 additional countries through technology partners and self-service options in a bid to boost revenue.
why: Monetization strategies for generative AI platforms indicate how artificial intelligence companies plan to transition user engagement into sustainable revenue streams.

impacts.name: OpenAI
impacts.why: Expanding ad options into new international markets helps transition user engagement into sustainable revenue streams.
